subject: anaesthesia
title: Intravenous Induction: Ketamine Dissociation, Emergence Reactions, and Etomidate

steps.title: Dissociative Anaesthesia State
steps.tx: **Dissociative anaesthesia characteristics** induced by ketamine represent a unique electrophysiological dissociation between the limbic system and the neocortex. Patients enter a cataleptic state where the eyes remain open with a slow nystagmic gaze, corneal and laryngeal protective reflexes remain active, purposeful skeletal movement is abolished, and profound somatic analgesia and amnesia are established following an intravenous dose of 1 to 2 mg/kg.

steps.title: NMDA Receptor Antagonism
steps.tx: **Ketamine NMDA receptor antagonism** acts via non-competitive inhibition of the phencyclidine binding site within the N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor-gated calcium ion channel complex. By preventing excitatory glutamate neurotransmission, ketamine suppresses dorsal horn central sensitization (wind-up phenomenon), rendering it a formidable analgesic for neuropathic pain and opioid-tolerant surgical patients.

rows: Abolishes spinal dorsal horn wind-up pain
Maintains cardiac output in acute shock
Contributes to emergence delirium and bronchodilation

steps.title: Sympathetic Cardiovascular Stimulation
steps.tx: **Indirect sympathetic activation by ketamine** stimulates central sympathetic nervous system outflow while inhibiting peripheral neuronal uptake of norepinephrine. In hemodynamically stable patients, this produces transient elevations in heart rate, systemic blood pressure, cardiac output, and myocardial oxygen consumption, making ketamine the induction agent of choice for acute hypovolemic shock, trauma resuscitation, and cardiac tamponade.

left.title: Intact Catecholamine Reserves (Trauma Shock)
points: Maintains systemic arterial blood pressure and organ perfusion

right.title: Depleted Catecholamine Stores (ICU Sepsis)
points: Sympathetic compensatory mechanisms are completely exhausted
Unmasks direct negative inotropic myocardial depression
Can trigger abrupt paradoxical hypotension and cardiovascular collapse

steps.title: Bronchodilation and Airway Mechanics
steps.tx: **Potent bronchodilatory action of ketamine** makes it the undisputed induction agent of choice for patients in severe acute bronchospasm or status asthmaticus. Ketamine relaxes bronchial smooth muscle through two synergistic mechanisms: indirect sympathetic stimulation of beta-2 adrenergic receptors and direct antagonistic blockade of voltage-sensitive calcium channels and muscarinic receptors on bronchial myocytes.

nodes.label: Administer IV ketamine 1.5 to 2 mg/kg in acute asthma
Immediate reduction in peak airway pressures and wheezing

steps.title: Emergence Delirium and Hallucinations
steps.tx: **Ketamine emergence delirium phenomena** occur in up to 10 to 30 percent of adult patients emerging from ketamine anaesthesia, manifesting as vivid colourful dreams, floating sensory distortions, frightening illusions, and acute psychomotor delirium. The incidence is substantially reduced by co-administering intravenous benzodiazepines (midazolam 2 to 4 mg), ensuring a quiet dark recovery room, or using the purified S-enantiomer.

steps.title: Cerebral Hemodynamics Controversy
steps.tx: **Cerebral blood flow and ICP with ketamine** traditionally discouraged its use in neurotrauma because ketamine causes cerebral vasodilation, increasing cerebral blood flow (CBF), cerebral metabolic rate (CMRO2), and intracranial pressure (ICP). However, modern neurocritical care demonstrates that when normocapnia is maintained via controlled mechanical ventilation alongside concurrent GABAergic sedation, ketamine safely preserves cerebral perfusion pressure without causing dangerous ICP spikes.

left.title: Spontaneous Respiration Setting
points: Direct cerebral vasodilation synergizes with hypercapnia

right.title: Controlled Mechanical Ventilation
points: Co-administration of propofol or midazolam blunts vasodilation
Safely maintains cerebral perfusion pressure in neurotrauma

steps.title: Etomidate Hemodynamic Stability
steps.tx: **Etomidate pristine cardiovascular stability** stems from its unique carboxylated imidazole structure. Administered at 0.2 to 0.3 milligrams per kilogram, etomidate induces rapid hypnosis via GABA-A receptor activation with virtually zero impact on myocardial contractility, cardiac output, or systemic vascular resistance, making it the premier induction agent for patients with severe aortic stenosis, severe coronary artery disease, or congestive heart failure.

steps.title: Myoclonus and Pain on Etomidate
steps.tx: **Adverse motor effects of etomidate** include involuntary myoclonic muscle jerking observed in up to 50 to 70 percent of un-premedicated patients, caused by transient disinhibition of subcortical extrapyramidal pathways rather than epileptic cortical activity. In addition, formulation in propylene glycol causes significant pain on peripheral venous injection and high rates of postoperative nausea and vomiting.
